earnings.title: GE AEROSPACE ANNOUNCES THIRD QUARTER 2026 RESULTS
highlights: Cash from operating activities (GAAP) of $2.2B, (14)%; free cash flow* $2.0B, (14)%

Increased material input from priority suppliers double-digits year-over-year, contributing to strong year-to-date Commercial Engines & Services (CES) services revenue and total engine deliveries, including LEAP growing 26%.

quotes.text: We delivered strong results this quarter as solid demand drove orders up 49%, with strength in commercial services up 23%, total revenue up 18% and EPS up 36%.

outlook: Year-to-date orders, revenue and total engine deliveries up over 20%, raising full-year guidance

In 2026, CES now expects revenue growth of low 20s, up from our prior guide of ~20%, driven by higher services revenue, which we now expect to grow at the higher end of our prior guide of low 20s, and equipment revenue growth of low 20s, up from ~20%.
Operating profit is expected to be in the range of $10.5-$10.6 billion, up from our prior guide of $10.25-$10.35 billion, driven by higher services growth and reduced GE9X impact.
In 2026, DPT continues to expect revenue growth of low double digits and operating profit of $1.6-$1.7 billion.
